CustomField.description: Indica si el caso debe enviarse a revisión manual.
CustomField.formula: AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(reconciliationStatus__c, "Conciliado")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(reconciliationStatus__c, "Duplicado")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(reconciliationStatus__c, "Rechazado")), OR(confidenceScore__c < 0.70, candidateCount__c > 1, ISPICKVAL(reconciliationStatus__c, "Requiere revision")))
CustomField.label: Revisión manual requerida
